name: Homarr v1 (Legacy)
description: Homarr v1 dashboard, pinned at v1.63.0. Use Homarr v2 for new installs. This version uses a different data structure from Homarr v0 and requires SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Not compatible with legacy Homarr (v0.x) data without migration.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-homarr-v1 application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-homarr-v1
  # The `big-bear-homarr-v1` service definition
  big-bear-homarr-v1:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-homarr-v1
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr:v1.63.0@sha256:6daf640531c1c114ccce15775185b3fb8958365a62c2fabc559d9cc5ae064326
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting docker.sock to allow docker management via Homarr
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      # Mounting the local homarr directory to /appdata inside the container
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/appdata:/appdata
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      # Secret encryption key for securing sensitive data (64 character hex string)
      # Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
      - SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY=
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 7575 of the host to port 7575 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:7575"
